name: cr701_23_surgical_extraction_counts_the_owners_zones
why: CR 701.23 / 608.2c: Surgical Extraction's three ChangeZone links cap each move at ChangeNum$, the cards in that zone of the target's owner (TargetedController$CardsInGraveyard / CardsInHand / CardsInLibrary). The parser dropped the amounts (an amount_expr finding); now kept and counted, every Lightning Bolt of Player B's graveyard, hand and library is exiled. Player A's own graveyard is empty, so counting the caster's moves nothing - M13 (a)
expect_order: Player A casts Surgical Extraction targeting Lightning Bolt
Player A moves 2 card\(s\) named Lightning Bolt from Player B's zone to exile
Player A moves 1 card\(s\) named Lightning Bolt from Player B's zone to exile
Player A moves 1 card\(s\) named Lightning Bolt from Player B's zone to exile
